support_illustration.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL square illustration for the thank-you footer of an academic robotics GitHub README. No reference images. A gentle, honest-looking little capybara with natural warm brown fur, small round ears, a broad blunt brown muzzle, small simple dark eyes and a tiny peaceful smile. Sitting upright on a simple wooden stool, holding a single small white daisy with a yellow center carefully in both front paws as a quiet thank-you gift. Clearly recognizable capybara anatomy and coloring; modest and calm rather than expressive or pleading. Soft hand-painted gouache and colored-pencil picture-book style with subtle paper texture, not 3D plastic. Muted warm cream background with generous whitespace and a faint soft ground shadow, no room scene. Full character visible, centered, simple forms readable at 150 pixels. No yellow cartoon animal, no hippo, no duck, no orange muzzle, no heart hand gesture, no heart symbol, no star prop, no robot, no huge eyes, no sparkly eyes, no tears, no blush, no raised eyebrows, no exaggerated grin, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo or watermark. Warm, sincere, understated, kind-hearted.
support_illustration.concept: Original warm brown capybara offering a white daisy, hand-painted picture-book style.
support_illustration.role: Decorative thank-you illustration only; not a simulation result.
